news.summary: Especialistas avaliam que cenário abre espaço para novas captações, mas alertam para riscos fiscais e inflacionários

news.summary: US President Trump criticised Ukraine’s Volodymyr Zelenskyy as he called for new leadership in Ukraine.

news.summary: The team en route to the suspected crash site aim finally to solve the mystery of her 1937 disappearance.

news.summary: Adam Barron is an independent Middle East political analyst and consultant, specialising primarily in Yemen, where he has reported from the capital, Sanaa, for The Economist. He writes for Foreign Policy and The Atlantic.

news.title: At least twelve killed, multiple people wounded in attack on Riyadh airport
news.summary: At least twelve people were killed in an attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport on Saturday, including an Egyptian flight attendant, according to a medical source at a local hospital. Earlier this week, another attack on the airport by the Houthis killed three people and damaged a plane, though the Iran-backed group did not announce any new attacks on Saturday.

news.title: Riyadh airport suspends operations after attack leaves multiple people wounded
news.summary: Saudi authorities on Saturday said that they had suspended operations at Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport after a new attack there left multiple people wounded. An attack on the airport by the Houthis on Thursday killed three people and damaged a plane, though the Iran-backed group did not announce any new attacks on Saturday.

news.title: Nine killed in shooting in US state of Pennsylvania, including two children
news.summary: The shooting in Erie, Pennsylvania happened on Friday, according to state officials. The attacker is among the dead.

news.title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
news.summary: Pike's lawyers say she is "grateful" to the medical team who cared for her after she survived two lethal injections last month.

news.title: Convicted murderer Christa Pike leaves hospital, returns to prison after botched execution
news.summary: Christa Pike's lawyers on Saturday said that the 50-year-old convicted murderer has been discharged from the hospital and returned to prison. Pike was transported to the hospital in critical condition on September 30 after she survived Tennessee's botched effort to execute her for murdering a classmate when she was a teenager.

news.title: Pope says death penalty ‘inadmissible’ as US plans to livestream execution
news.summary: Pope Leo XIV describes capital punishment as an 'attack on the inviolability and dignity of the person' in post on X.

news.title: Christa Pike discharged from hospital and returned to Tennessee prison
news.summary: Pike survived two doses of lethal-injection drugs on September 30, renewing scrutiny of capital punishment.

news.title: Trump censura a Zelenski y pide "un nuevo presidente" para Ucrania
news.summary: El presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, ha cargado este sábado contra el presidente ucraniano, Volodimir Zelenski, y ha defendido que el país tenga "un nuevo presidente".

news.title: Christa Pike regresa a prisión tras el alta hospitalaria después de sobrevivir a dos inyecciones letales
news.summary: Christa Pike, la mujer condenada a muerte por asesinato en primer grado de una compañera de clase en 1996 --cuando tenía 19 años-- y que fue hospitalizada hace más de una semana tras su ejecución fallida con dos inyecciones letales hace una semana, ha recibido ya el alta hospitalaria y ha regresardo a prisión.

news.title: Los hutíes atacan de nuevo el Aeropuerto de Riad
news.summary: Las milicias hutíes han atacado este sábado el Aeropuerto Internacional Rey Jalid de Riad y habrían causado heridos, evacuación de parte de sus instalaciones y la cancelación de algunos vuelos.

news.title: India protests: New 'cockroach' movement leader named
news.summary: Indian police detained the head of the satirical "cockroach" online movement on Saturday, the group said, ahead of a major protest against the Election Commission that prompted strict security measures. "They seem to have seen that coming," notes France 24's Andrew Hilliar. In a prerecorded video, Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the Cockroach Party, names an interim leader to take over.

news.title: South Africa: Anti-migrant unrest flares in Durban
news.summary: Police in Durban were battling a fresh wave of anti-migrant unrest. Shops were looted, homes were torched and foreign nationals were targeted as crowds took to the streets for a second day. The violence has revived fears of rising xenophobic tensions over immigration.

news.title: Kenya: Ebola tests negative as contact tracing continues
news.summary: Tests have come back negative for a person suspected of having Ebola who was reportedly in quarantine at a hospital, following rumours circulating over the past 24 hours. Meanwhile, in Nairobi, authorities are racing to trace contacts of Kenya's first Ebola death, reported on Monday. Our correspondent Bastien Renouil tells us more.

news.title: Abbas postpones Palestinian elections, sets presidential poll for September 2027
news.summary: Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas on Saturday postponed legislative elections due next month until September 11, ​2027, and called ‌a presidential poll for the same date, blaming Israel and the security situation in the Palestinian territories for the ⁠delay. Our correspondent in Jerusalem Noga Tarnopolsky tells us more.

news.title: Midterms: "It does look like the Republicans will lose control of the House of Representatives"
news.summary: Most of the political world is focused on next month's midterm elections in the US. "It does look like the Republicans will lose control of the House of Representatives," says our guest, Bruce Stokes, a visiting senior fellow at the German Marshall Fund of the United States.
